# N8N Workflows

> Catalog of 8,000+ ready-to-use n8n automation workflow templates, searchable by category, node type and author. Every workflow has a detail page, an importable JSON download, and an agent-friendly markdown rendering (send the HTTP header `Accept: text/markdown` on any page to get markdown instead of HTML).

## Browse

- [All workflows](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/): Latest n8n workflow templates
- [Popular workflows](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/popular): Most-used templates
- [Recently added](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/recent): Newest templates
- [Categories](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/categories): Browse by use case
- [Nodes](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/nodes): Browse by n8n node type
- [Authors](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/authors): Browse by template author
- [Search](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/search): Full-text search across the catalog

## For agents

- [API reference](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/docs/api): REST endpoints for programmatic access
- [API catalog](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of available APIs
- [Agent skills](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Installable agent skill manifest
- [Sitemap](https://n8nworkflows.xyz/sitemap-index.xml): Full URL index for all workflows

## How to use a workflow

- Open any workflow detail page, e.g. https://n8nworkflows.xyz/workflows/{slug}
- Download the importable JSON: https://n8nworkflows.xyz/api/download/{id} (the trailing number in each slug is the canonical id)
- In n8n, open Workflows, choose Import from File / URL, and paste the JSON
